timing_boundary: POSIX /usr/bin/time real value for one uninterrupted command; UTC start and completion lines were emitted immediately outside the command boundary.
local_evidence_boundary: The pass used all registered local source captures, including two Chemistry assets larger than ordinary GitHub per-file limits. Their separate distribution remains a publication-packaging task and did not alter this run.
planning_guidance: Reserve at least two hours on comparable hardware and allow several hours on ordinary laptops. This is one measured reference run, not a cross-platform median or runtime guarantee.
scientific_boundary: Elapsed time is operational evidence only. A run is scientifically accepted only when every verification stage passes and the terminal pass line is emitted.
